## Done when

- [ ] Twelve levels ship, the registry check passes, and no migration is added.
- [ ] The floor, pair, spread and distinct-offer tests pass, and the 400s for a pick, a token and a chase hold.
- [ ] The picture, face, palette and Collection tests pass, the daily sweep included.
- [ ] The component spec typechecks, and either it ran or the report says why not.
- [ ] Every harness check, typecheck, eslint and `classify --claims` pass.

## Risks

- **`from`** must default to 0 and be skipped at 0, so old logs and offers serialize unchanged.
- **A wrong `ownPicture`** re-seeds Woodcut, Neon or a Legacy card. The seed tests catch it.
- **Gold.** Blurred or leaded mixes of the 27-colour cut can land in gold, so keep the glow slate and test the mixes.
- **Time.** A full sweep per PR blows the web job's five minutes. It is sampled per PR and full daily.
- **Seeded pull tests** may draw other ids from the larger pool. Change an expectation only once the roll's rules are confirmed to hold.
- **`variant-ladders.cy.tsx`.** `classicplus-012` gains three ladders, and its rungs may overflow the shot.

## Open questions

I made these decisions myself, each with the alternative I rejected:
- **Floor of 3 via paired splits.** Rejected: hand lists of cards, which every later card would need, and a floor of 2, which is not "several".
- **The normal frame.** Rejected: new frames, more CSS for each.
- **No full-art or signed level.** Rejected: more Mythic chases.
- **Ideas dropped.** Golden hour sits in the gold window. Chibi and the home location need new subject drawing in every painter. Blueprint needs an offer by tag, and a card back already has its name.
- **Names** were chosen to avoid the "Stained glass" finish and the "Tarot" card back.

A person may retune the rarities or the 60/40 weights.

## Goal

M #50 CN Tech and M+ #2 NA Tech pick from a **win-rate snapshot the game is handed at its start**. The server takes it from the cached `/api/stats/cards` report (R1367000) and passes it as `CreateGameOptions.winRates`. The game keeps it in `GameState.winRates`, fixed for the whole game, and its record keeps it (`ReplayInput.winRates`, `matches.win_rates`), so a fold reaches the same hash.

A game with no snapshot reads the frozen table of the shipped catalog it folds under (older records, R1266000), else nothing: CN Tech then adds Lunar Eclipse and NA Tech fuses its two fallbacks (R2521007).

The leader is the highest lower Wilson bound and the trailer the lowest upper bound, both in integers. The ladder bots' deal (#750) reads the server's snapshot, passed in. The compiled `crates/cards/data/win_rates.json`, `cargo jackioh winrates` and the `winRates` fragment claim retire.

## Done when

- [ ] Rematch: both components mounted send one status request per tick (R3207002).
- [ ] Population reads on mount, then every 30 s, and the auth poll keeps 2 s (R3207000).
- [ ] The banner reads every 10 s and the queue follow keeps 2 s (R3207001).
- [ ] `/decks` and `/play` mount with one `/api/auth/me`, and the friends panel sends none for a kept, game-free account (R3207003).

- [ ] The harness's `cargo test --workspace …` leaves `apps/web/src/wire` clean.

## Risks

- **A gate answer can be 45 s old (R3206000).**
  - If `/play` redirected on it, a quick concede followed by Back to lobby would bounce the player back into the finished match. So a game-naming answer is always read again; step 6 and `pairTargetOf` implement that.
  - The friends panel follows the same rule so Challenge never sticks off after a match ends. A stale "no game" answer only enables Challenge, and the server still refuses it (rule 7).
- **Rematch poller scope.** It is keyed by match id and uses the first joiner's token. The effect's `[token, matchId]` deps leave and rejoin on a renewal, so the last leaver stops it and the next joiner restarts it with the new token. A leaked poller would show as a test that does not unmount, so `cleanup` runs in `afterEach`.
- **StrictMode (dev only).** Effects run twice, so the first-run snapshot in step 6 is spent and `/play` reads once more. This is harmless and matches today's double read.
- **Generated file.** The `every_name_is_listed_once` count must be bumped exactly, or `export_config` fails. `serverConfig.ts` is not hand-edited.
- **Spec check.** Every `R3207…` cited in code needs its note. Every `proven_in` file needs an `it("R3207… …")` or `fn r3207…_…` title with the id as a whole word.
- **Hidden information.** None is read or kept; these are the account's own answers (rule 7).

## Open questions

- **Difficulty:** `medium` holds. About 25 files, no engine, AI or migration. The only cross-crate link is the generated constants file.
- **30 s and 10 s.** Both are the low end of the issue's ranges. A person who prefers 60 s or 15 s changes one constant and the generated file; the tests read the constants.
- **Both constants are server constants.** The issue asks for a server constant for the population poll. For the banner it says only "a new named constant", but the acceptance says "constants" and the neighbouring poll constants live in `config.rs`. A client-only constant in `liveGame.ts` was rejected.
- **Friends panel uses the page's kept answer of any age**, not only one inside `READ_CACHE_FRESH_MS`. A 45 s window would still read once per screen in the common case, which defeats the issue's point. A person can decide otherwise.

**Goal.** A pack buy sends one spend and no reads. An open sends one spend and no reads until its scene closes. When it closes, the Shop makes at most two reads, `/api/tokens` and `/api/cosmetic-packs`. Each spend's answer is folded into the panels that show it: the wallet, the unopened counts, pity and the token bars. The server still decides everything (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The client adds up no held tokens and no cosmetic-pack count, so it re-reads those. `net/api.ts` already folds each answer into the kept cache (R3206000), so no net-layer change is needed. The cost is in `routes/shop.tsx`, which bumps every other panel's `revision` on every spend, in `forgetOwnedCosmetics()` per spend, and in `CosmeticPacks.open`'s own second read of collection and cosmetics.

**Goal.** While a seat's match socket is open, the server pushes that seat a versioned frame. A match in no series gets a `rematch` frame and a Conquest game gets a `series` frame. The server sends one on every greeting and again whenever the rematch book, a seat's presence or the series changes. Each frame holds only what that seat's own `GET /api/matches/:id/rematch` or `GET /api/matches/:id/series` answers (CLAUDE.md rule 7). The client keeps the frames in the match snapshot and sends no rematch or series-banner read while the open socket has pushed one. Once the socket drops, or if it never pushed (an older server), the polls of R3207002 and R3205000 run as today. ts-rs generates the frame type into `apps/web/src/wire/generated/`. Its version is the server constant `POST_GAME_FRAME_VERSION`: an older client ignores both new `type`s, and this client drops any other `v`. Ruling R3213000 records every choice.

## Goal

Each signed-in tab holds one WebSocket at `/ws/social`. The server pushes three kinds of frame over it:
- `social`: the caller's challenges and unread counts, exactly the body `GET /api/social` returns.
- `chat`: a nudge when a chat message is sent.
- `friends`: a nudge when the caller's friends list changes.

While the socket is up, the tab sends no social poll and no chat poll. The polls start again when the socket drops, and older clients keep polling.

The socket signs in the way `/ws/match` does: R1379000, R2478000 and §9.4's gate. Its session is checked again every R194 window. It is capped per account, and it has a per-address count of its own. The work is done when there are server tests, client tests, ruling R3214000, and the route listed in the server README.

## Goal

Add `apps/web/src/spacing.css`, a named spacing scale that `index.css` imports beside the other scales. Move every `gap`, `padding` and `margin` in the board sheets onto it, with each value rounded to a step by at most 2 px. Add `src/spacing.test.ts`, which holds the board sheets to zero fixed lengths and every other sheet to its allowlisted count, which can only go down. Describe the scale in `apps/web/README.md`. CSS and web tests only: no spec section, ruling or crate applies.

## Files to touch

| File | | What |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/spacing.css` | new | `:root` with `--space-1` to `--space-11` |
| `apps/web/src/spacing.test.ts` | new | the scale, the board rule and the `UNMIGRATED` allowlist |
| `apps/web/src/index.css` | change | import `spacing.css` after `motion.css`; migrate its spacing; `--gap` |
| `apps/web/src/game/{activate,animations,board,clock,facedown,lanePick,leanNewest,market,modifierList,notices,overflow,prompt,reveal,starscape,trade}.css` | change | migrate spacing; `board.css` also has two `--gap` lines |
| `apps/web/src/game/{craft/craft,drag/drag,showcase/showcase}.css` | change | migrate spacing |
| `apps/web/README.md` | change | one paragraph after the motion paragraph (line 54) |
| `apps/web/src/routes/Rematch.test.tsx` | change | line ~234 asserts `padding: 8px 18px` in `animations.css` |
| `apps/web/src/cards/cardState.test.tsx` | change | line ~504 asserts `padding:\s*0 3px` on `board.css`'s `.board button.buried-badge` |

Do not touch these: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `crates/`, `spec/`, `game/deckbuilder/*`, `game/table.css`, and any menu sheet (`routes/`, `auth/`, `practice/` and the rest). Those keep their raw lengths, and the allowlist freezes them.

## Decisions

The issue's example is a pure 4 px scale. I chose a scale that is 2 px-granular up to 12 px, because the board's most used lengths are 6 px (about 100 uses) and 10 px (about 60). On a 4 px scale each of those moves by 2 px. Re-pick this if you prefer the example.

- **Steps.** 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 40 px, numbered `--space-1` to `--space-11`.
- **Rounding.** Round to the nearest step, counting `0` as a step. A tie goes to the smaller one. Nothing grows by more than 2 px (the largest are 30→32 and 14.4→16), and a menu page can't newly overflow spec 46.
- **Composed lengths.** 28, 36, 48 and 132 px are 4 px or more from any step, so they are composed from steps and stay exact.
- **Relative terms stay.** `em`, `%`, `vh` and `env()` terms and `var(--tray-channel)` stay. An `em` spacing scales with its box, as the type scale's em forms do.
- **Rem.** `rem` becomes px at 16 px, because `html` sets no size. Those rems are all in `game/market.css`.
- **`--gap`.** `--gap` was `6px`, and `4px` on a phone. It becomes `var(--space-3)`, and `var(--space-2)` on a phone.

```css
   A step is a length in px, smallest first, numbered from 1: 2px apart to 12px, where the board's own
   lengths sit, then 4px and 8px apart. A new step goes in order and raises the list in that test. */

:root {
  --space-1: 2px;
  --space-2: 4px;

  --space-9: 24px;
  --space-10: 32px;
  --space-11: 40px;
}
```

## Done when

- [ ] `/decks` draws the workshop frame in every state; the loading bar shows Back left and the gear right, and the `h1` is "Decks" before and after.
- [ ] The before-and-after test (step 13) passes.
- [ ] `LinkedAccounts` and `TwoStepSettings` render a `Skeleton` while waiting, with their `role="status"` sentence kept.
- [ ] The workshop with no decks renders the rail's `EmptyState` with "New deck", and `workshop-empty` is untouched.
- [ ] `FriendsButton` and `CosmeticPacks` use `EmptyState`.
- [ ] The README still-text list is extended, and `R3228000.md` and `spec/pending/3228.md` exist.
- [ ] The delay test (step 14) passes; `SKELETON_DELAY_MS` is not changed.
- [ ] The test commands above, typecheck, eslint, and the harness checks (rustfmt, `spec check`, clippy, `patches check`, cargo tests, web tests) are green.
- [ ] The report says whether Cypress 46 and 47 ran. If they could not run in this sandbox, say so and do not call them green; CI runs them.

## Risks

- **#1524 regression.** The loading bar now has a gear. A settings dialog opened during the wait closes when the decks land, because the loading frame and the workshop are different trees. The issue requires the gear, and the wait is short or skipped with kept decks (R2125000). The ruling records this cost and the rejected fix; the builder must not hide it.
- **Frame drift.** The workshop's frame now lives in one component. Keep the class string and the `header.db-header` structure exact, because CSS (`.tavern.deckbuilder.app-shell`, `.db-header`) and the e2e bar helpers depend on them.
- **E2E 46 and 47.**
  - Loaded `/decks` differs only when an account has no decks: the rail's `EmptyState` is taller than the old hint. Estimated height is about 450 px on a 390×844 phone, so it fits.

- **Scope of the "other texts" sweep.** The plan moves only `FriendsButton` and `CosmeticPacks`, and lists the rest as still text. If a person wants the leaderboard's Jlorious line, the account's "No finished matches yet" line or the deck history popover moved too, that is a follow-up. Moving them risks the one-screen budgets that spec 46 measures.
- **The `#1524` guard.** If a person wants the settings dialog to survive the decks landing, that needs the bar hoisted above both states. This plan does not do that.

## Log
(earlier lines of the log were cut here)
.zone > .field-badges` rule:
  - contains `position: absolute;`, `top: var(--badges-inset);`, `left: var(--badges-inset);`, `--badges-inset: 2px;`, `pointer-events: none;`, `max-height: calc((100cqh + var(--field-card-h)) / 2 - var(--badges-stat) - var(--badges-plate) - var(--badges-inset));`;
  - contains no `right:`, `wrap-reverse` or `--badges-top`;

- `#3257 the Activate press band starts at the control and stops at the zone`. activate.css contains `height: min(var(--hit-min), calc(100cqh - var(--badges-inset)));` and no `--badges-top`.

**`field-badges.test.tsx`.** Keep the existing tests. Add `vi` and an `afterEach` that calls `vi.restoreAllMocks()`. Add a `stubLayout(maxHeight)` helper that:
- passes `getComputedStyle` through, except it returns `{ maxHeight }` for `.field-badges`;
- spies the `offsetHeight` getter (control 16, `.keyword` or `.cf-kw-more` 12, else 0);
- spies the `offsetTop` getter as the sum of earlier marks' heights plus 2 per gap.

Then, for unit `b1` (control plus Rush and Can't Defend):
- `"60px"` draws both chips and no `.cf-kw-more`.
- `"30.6px"` draws no chip and `.cf-kw-more` reads `+2`, its title containing "Rush".
- `"10px"` draws no chip and no `+N`; the control stays.

**`board-layout.cy.tsx`.** Inside the `for (const size of SIZES)` loop of the `#2876, #2932` describe, delete the three `#2932` badge specs (l.788–988) and add the four below.

- Imports: add `baseView, emptySide, faceDownBackrow, unit` to the fixtures import.
- Mark selector: `.activate-control, .keyword-icon, .cf-kw-more`.
- Helper `badged(position, keywords)`:
  - Build it from `fullBoardView()`.
  - Set `activations: [{ ability: "ping", label: "Deal 1 damage.", usesLeft: 1, usable: true }]` on `you.units[0]`, `[2]` and `[4]` (lanes 1, 3, 5).
  - Give those units `keywords: [{ kind: "Rush" as const }, { kind: "Can't Defend" as const }]` and `position`.

1. **Empty zones.**
   - Mount `baseView` with `you` and `opponent` from `emptySide`. Put one `unit(...)` in `you.units[2]`, one in `opponent.units[1]`, and `faceDownBackrow` in `you.backrow[4]`.
   - For every `.zone` in the field, read `getComputedStyle(zone, "::before")`.
   - Occupied zone: `display === "none"`.
   - Empty zone:
     - `display !== "none"` and `pointerEvents === "none"`;
     - width ÷ height within `FIELD_RATIO_MIN - 0.03` to `FIELD_RATIO_MAX + 0.03`;
     - width and height ≤ `insideOf(zone)` + `SLACK_PX`.
   - Expect all four rows and five lanes covered and at least 15 empty zones.
2. **Badges inside the zone.** For ATK, then DEF, and for lanes 1, 3 and 5:
   - Every mark's rect lies within its `.zone` rect ±1px.
   - The first mark's left and top are within 4px of the zone's inside corner (border widths added).
   - No mark overlaps the zone's `:scope > .switch-button` rect or any other `.zone` rect.
   - The control's band (`getComputedStyle(control, "::before")` top, left, right, height, from the control's padding box as the old spec did) lies within the zone rect ±1px and is ≤ `TOUCH_PX` tall.
   - `elementFromPoint` at the control's centre is the control.
   - ATK only: no mark overlaps `.card-name` or any `.stat` of its card, and the lowest mark's bottom ≤ the name's top.
   - Compare DEF rects to the ATK rects (`closeTo 0.5`), as the old spec did.
3. **Overflow.** One unit with six keywords (`(["Rush","Can't Defend","Charge","First Strike","Poisonous","Lifesteal"] as const).map((kind) => ({ kind }))`) and an Activate. Its stack has a `.cf-kw-more` whose text matches `/^\+\d+$/` with N ≥ 4. All marks are inside the zone, and the lowest mark's bottom ≤ the name's top.
4. **Cost.** The lane-3 badged unit's `.cost-gem` has `visibility: hidden`. A unit with no marks, a `fullBoardView` unit with no keywords or activations such as `you.units[3]`, keeps `visible`.

## Done when

- [ ] Empty zones keep a card-shaped placeholder inside the zone (ratio 0.72–0.86 ± inset), hidden once occupied and still hit-less and green as a drop spot.
- [ ] Badges sit in their own zone's top-left corner with the whole band inside the zone.
- [ ] Badges never touch the name, attack, health or ⟳. Cost is covered and hidden.
- [ ] Overflow folds into `+N`.
- [ ] DEF rects equal ATK rects.
- [ ] `--badges-top`, `--switch-*` use in the stack and the lane-1 rule are gone.
- [ ] The vitest files above pass, plus the web typecheck, eslint and `typecheck:component`.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `catalog check`, `patches check` and `spec check` unchanged and green; classify is `kind:app`.
- [ ] The rest of #2932 is untouched, and nothing outside the table changed.

## Risks

- **DEF.** The stack is identical in ATK and DEF (spec), so over a DEF card, which is turned 90°, it lies on the turned card's left strip: the attack gem and the end of the rotated name (seen in a Chromium prototype). The no-cover assertions are therefore ATK-only; see Open questions.
- **Plate numbers duplicated.** They are copied from cards.css; the guard test catches drift. Full-art units have a lower plate, so the formula stays conservative.
- **Cypress specs unrun.** The binary is absent and the specs are daily-only. The numbers above came from real measurement, so the specs are specified, not guessed.
- **Cards folder.** Do not edit `apps/web/src/cards/`. `MinionFace.tsx` comments still say "hanging off"; leave them.
- **Hooks.** `FieldBadges` has no hooks (they live in `Stack`), so the early `return null` is safe.
- **ResizeObserver.** Re-measure only when width or height changes, or a fresh mount flickers.

## Open questions

1. **DEF.** Should DEF cards keep the stack over their turned left strip, or should the stack avoid it, which would break "identical rects"? The plan follows the issue literally.
2. **Cramped phones.** At 390×664 there is room for Activate plus one chip. With two or more keywords the unit shows Activate plus `+N` and no named chip. Accept?
3. **Screenshots.** The PR's phone screenshots (main vs. this change, via `.claude/skills/ui-walkthrough`) cannot be attached by the bot, which has no GitHub access. A person must add them.
4. **Difficulty.** The rule gives `difficulty:medium`: about 10 files, no engine, AI, migration or cross-crate work.

A won boss whose dealt drop is already held (taken at the first mini-boss, bought in a shop, or found in a chest) now offers a different relic. Today `fight_won` turns the held drop into no reward. ## Goal

`face_threat_with` should count an attack as able to reach the hero only when `attack_restriction` lets its Unit hit the hero. While The Gauntlet (S #157, R1849005) acts, a Unit in lanes 2 to 4 then adds no face damage, on either side, whichever seat holds The Gauntlet. The new read sits behind a new `EvalWeights` flag, `gauntlet_bars_face_attacks`, which is on in `AI_EVAL` and off in `GREEDY_EVAL`, so the greedy yardstick stays frozen. Without a Gauntlet on the field, `face_threat` gives the same numbers as today.

The acceptance criteria map to the tests below:
- Gauntlet up with the enemy's Units in lanes 2 to 4: `face_threat` is 0 and `wall_switches` offers nothing. That is test 1.
- A Unit in lane 1 or 5 still counts. That is test 2.
- No Gauntlet: no change. That is test 3 plus the existing fixtures.
- `GREEDY_EVAL` behaves as before. That is test 4, plus `cargo jackioh gate` at smoke size.

Where this departs from the earlier plan, and why. A scratch test on today's code, deleted afterwards, showed the following:
- **The earlier wall test could not fail.** It put the AI's 7/7 in lane 1. With The Gauntlet up and the enemy in lanes 2 to 4, `wall_switches` is already `[]` today, because a lane-1 Taunt binds no attacker inside The Gauntlet. The 7/7 has to stand inside The Gauntlet (lane 3): today that board offers the switch, and after the fix it must not.
- **The health-4 case does not tell the two apart.** It gives the same walls before and after. This plan adds health 5, and a Taunt inside The Gauntlet facing an attacker outside it; both cases change.
- **The comment on `AI_EVAL` is dropped.** The field's doc comment says the same thing.

## Goal

Both jobs named in #3314, `rust (test server practice)` (7m 10s) and `rust (test server practice rulings)` (7m 4s), should finish under 5 minutes. I found that main already fixes the cause, so no count or new test binary is needed. The build records that finding where the next bot will read it, and reports the measured times.

**What I found.** I measured everything below on 4 cores. Both groups run only tests from `crates/server/tests/api/practice.rs`, through `--test server`.

- **Cause.** `honest_win()` is called by three tests in each group. It waited about 150 s for the slowest game of a batch of seeds. #3305's plan measured 154 s of a 154 s group in it.
- **Fix already on main.** #3305 (PR #3307, commit `952de68e32`, 2026-11-06 15:05 UTC) stops games that can no longer be the first win.
- **Why the run was slow.** The reported run was on `bot/issue-3290` at `7c20d93`, whose merge-base with main is `ffa18b45f7` (13:32), before that fix. Its 7m 4s and 7m 10s match #3305's pre-fix 7m 1s, so this is the same cause and not a new regression.
- **Run time now.** With the fix, `api::practice::r` runs in 4.75 s and `api::practice:: --skip api::practice::r` in 3.92 s.
- **Compile time.** A cold build of the server test binary took 3m 18s with all dependencies. With dependencies cached, the workspace crates take about 160 s. A job is roughly 1 min of setup, 3 min of compile and 5 s of tests, so about 4 minutes.

**Why a count is the wrong fix.**

- The tests take about 4 s and every shard compiles the whole binary again, so a count would only add runners.
- Any `[rust-test]` count other than 1 fails `bot/tests/test_ci_matrix.py::test_the_committed_files_give_todays_jobs`. It pins `{(shard, shards)} == {(1, 1)}`, the web unit count at 8 and the e2e smoke count at 2.

Full `pnpm --dir apps/web test`: 555 files, 10280 passed, 80 skipped (pre-existing daily ones). fx-signature.cy.tsx now runs at FX_SPEED_MIN so the capture is mid-flight (rerun: 2/2).
Next: nothing; final report written.
Departures from plan: FX_FELINOR_STREAKS_MAX = 5 (one per unit zone); a non-Unit's signature may be { bespoke } or { setPiece }; galleryPlayOf puts entrance before aura; entranceEvent refuses a face-down (formerId) backrow landing; takeover's Field Spell yield also needs the landing in the entry and no reveal; tiers.test endOf counts shot/projectile flight and its resolver reads printed rarity; entrance.real.test.ts runs p2's board with dynamic music off so stings are held to R202 for real; musicScene.ts (plan missed) forwards playSting; wiring.test.tsx uses a recording music player (setMusicPlayerForTests).

## Log
(earlier lines of the log were cut here)
**`tiers.test.ts`**: `"R3332000 every signature ends within its rarity's and type's ceiling, shakes within its type's, and its aura within AURA_SIGNATURE_MAX_INTENSITY"`.
  - Plan each signature's gallery play over `galleryBoardOf`, then through `entranceEntries` and `setPieceEntries(…, takeoverClaim, { reduced: false, bigMoments: "full", speed: 1 })`.
  - Each cue ends at `offset + endOf(cue)` (pull and conceal excluded), where `offset` sums the durations of the entries before it.
  - That end is at most the rarity's ceiling, times `SIGNATURE_SPELL_SHARE` for a Spell, and every shake is at most its type's trauma.
  - The existing R2803000 loop also uses `galleryBoardOf`.
- **`constants.test.ts`**: `"R3332000 the signature budgets sit inside the caps"`. Legendary < Mythic ≤ `SET_PIECE_HOLD_CAP_MS`; the share is in (0, 1); every `AURA_LOOKS` value is at most the aura cap.

**Felinor Fiender**
- **`felinorFiender.test.ts`**
  - `"R3332001 Felinor Fiender assembles from each Felinor its controller shows"`: over `felinorBoard(fullBoardView())`:
    - three shots, in lane order, land at the slam;
    - none comes from lane 4's buried pile or from the other side;
    - a stacked-onto Felinor streaks from its foot;
    - the beats scale with D.
  - `"R3332001 with no Felinor it lands alone and no cue names a card"`.

**Table-driven looks and entrances**
- **`takeover.test.ts`**: the `TAKEOVER_LOOKS` line becomes a check that exactly the four printed Mythics carry `takeover`. Add `"R3332000 takeoverLookOf reads the table, prismatic by default"`.
- **`cardFx.test.ts`**: the R502 loop reads `CARD_RECIPES[entry.key]`, and every `entranceKeyOf` key is in `ENTRANCES`. Add `"R3332000 a Field Spell's own entrance plays as it lands face up and the shared Legendary entrance yields"`, using `core-093` (a Legendary Field Spell) and an injected `parseFxCardTable` table.
- **`setPieces.test.ts`** line 213 reads the table instead.

**Gallery**
- **`fx.test.tsx`**: 645 becomes 646 and Core's 91 becomes 92, comments included. Add `"R3332000 R3332001 the gallery lists every signature by set and plays Felinor Fiender's over its Felinors"`.

**Sting**
- **`cues.test.ts`**
  - `"R3332002 a Legendary or a Mythic with an intro takes no shared entrance; one without keeps it"`, with `core-092`, `core-100` and a made-up id.
  - At lines 1113 and 1121 the real tokens now expect none. Add a made-up printed-Legendary token that still gets `entrance`.
- **`musicDirector.test.ts`**: `"R3332002 with dynamic music off or the music at zero, a Legendary's and a Mythic's play stings from its own intro"`.
- **`music.test.ts`**: `"R3332002 a sting plays its intro's opening on the effects bus and fades out by MUSIC_STING_S"`.
- **`wiring.test.tsx`** lines 104, 109 and 140: `entrance` is now `[]`. Prove the catalog arrived through `summon`'s `timbre` and timing instead, and add R3332002 to their titles.
- **`entrance.real.test.ts`**: drop `sfx:entrance…` at lines 290, 294 and 301. Add `playSting` to the sink and hold it to R202 the way intros are.

**Component specs**
- **`fx-signature.cy.tsx`**: `"R3332001 Felinor Fiender's signature at ${w}x${h}"`, at 1280x720 and 390x844. It copies `mountShown` and `waitLit` from `fx-gallery-captures.cy.tsx`, runs `mountShown(board, withEvents(galleryFieldView(id, board), events))`, waits until lit and takes a screenshot.
- **`fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx`**: add a scene `"R3332001 Felinor Fiender's signature"` through `holdsBudget`.

**Commands**

The harness's own web step excludes `src/fx` and `src/audio`, so run those suites here:

1. `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`
2. `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/fx src/audio src/routes/dev src/game/entrance.real.test.ts src/routes/practice.test.tsx src/test`
3. `pnpm --dir apps/web test`
4. `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
5. `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component`
6. `pnpm exec eslint apps/edge apps/web e2e`
7. `E2E_COMPONENT_PORT=5281 pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/fx-signature.cy.tsx,cypress/component/fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx,cypress/component/fx-layer.cy.tsx`
8. `cargo jackioh spec check`
9. `cargo jackioh names --check`
10. `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`. Expect `kind:app` and no fragment, as #2992 needed none.

## Done when

- [ ] The frame parses on every eligible card. `TAKEOVER_LOOKS` and `{ bespoke: <entrance> }` are gone, and the eight cards plan as before: the `entrances`, `takeover` and `setPieces` suites and `fx-layer.cy` pass.
- [ ] The budgets are named, pinned constants, and `tiers.test.ts` holds every signature to them.
- [ ] `SIGNATURE_PENDING` holds exactly 164 ids.
- [ ] Felinor's signature plays in `/dev/fx` and at both viewports, and `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx` stays within `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`.
- [ ] The sting tests pass.
- [ ] The rulings, the pending paragraphs and the docs are written.
- [ ] Every command above and every harness check passes. Name any that could not run, Cypress included.

## Risks

- **R202.** Streaks read only the face-up tops and their public tags.
- **Pixels.** The four entrance recipes are untouched, and only a Field Spell's shared entrance yields.
- **Import cycles.** Felinor's file must not import `gallery.ts`.
- **Audio.** With dynamic music on, no synthesized sting plays over an intro any more. This is intended (R3332002). No asset is added, so the music and voice budgets hold.

## Open questions

- **"Permanent".** This plan reads it as a Unit or a Field Spell. A Trap's entrance is its firing, which its `cast` already draws (R2797000). Rejected: a reveal-time `entrance`, which would duplicate `cast`. A person may widen it.
- **The sting.** It is the first 1.4 s of every card's intro, with no per-card offset. Offsets for "a sting cut from it" can be added to `music-cards.json` later.
- **"Only shrink".** The exact list and review hold this, not a pinned count, because a new Legendary joins the list.
- **The signature flag.** `signature` is explicit, so the four moved marquees stay pending until their sets' passes add the text's beat. Rejected: deriving the tier from `entrance`, which would count Nature Titan, whose Cry is a shared motif.

## Goal

Every face-up Legendary or Mythic permanent on the board gets a tile aura under its card, in the colours of its own picture. Legendary gets a soft edge glow and slow motes. Mythic gets a richer pattern chosen by its set's look: runes, starfield, roots, circuitry or ink. A card's own table `aura` (signature) replaces the default. A touch on the card or its tile sends a ripple, plays a soft bell in the aura's colour, and buzzes on a phone. The aura brightens while the card is picked as a target, flickers on damage, dims while Dormant, Frozen or Silenced, and fades out with its `destroyed` or `exiled` row. It stays under the particle budgets, is still under reduced motion, and is off at fx intensity off. It is presentation only: no engine, wire or catalog change.

Design choice: the aura is a DOM element inside each `.zone`, not another canvas layer. `AuraLayer` is a fixed overlay above the cards and cannot sit under them. `.card` is `position: relative`, so an absolutely positioned first child of `.zone` paints below it.

The registry gains a data rule, `defaultOn` on a level. On a card whose face prints a listed rarity (for a token, its printed rarity), that level is the card's **default look**:
- The Default variant draws it, at both the normal face and `version-animated`.
- It is offered nowhere on those cards, so every pick, token, chase, drop and dev fill refuses or skips it with the existing 400s.
- Every account owns it there with no row, so the level above it in its variant is next for everyone.

`version-full-art` becomes the Mythics' default look and `version-extended-art` the Legendaries'. Existing rows of either stay. ## Goal

Every Epic-or-rarer face, and every full-art-shaped level, draws its picture as four stacked depth planes by painter role (far: back; middle: props; near: subject; nearest: over, light, motes). That face tilts toward the pointer up to `CARD_TILT_MAX_DEG` (12°) with the planes parallaxing by depth (`CARD_DEPTH_STEP_PX`) and springs back. It also tilts with the phone once a setting allows it, and with a drag in inspect. It carries a glare that moves opposite the tilt, drawn by area (frame and art apart, `color-dodge` and `overlay`, isolated, white only) and a frame-break on Legendary and Mythic faces in hand and inspect. A Common in its normal look, a delivered file, a Starship, a Legacy card, and reduced-motion, OS or fx-intensity-off faces stay flat. Web client, specs and one `--visual` fragment only: no Rust.

2. **pictures.ts** (after `ArtPart`, line ~79): `export type ArtPlane = "far"|"middle"|"near"|"nearest"`; `ART_PLANES` in that order; `ArtPart = "whole"|"backdrop"|"subject"|ArtPlane`; `PLANE_OF_ROLE: Record<ArtRole,ArtPlane>` = back→far, props→middle, subject→near, over/light/motes→nearest (`import type { ArtRole } from "./motion.ts"`). `partDraws(part, role)`: whole true; backdrop `role!=="subject"`; subject `role==="subject"`; plane `PLANE_OF_ROLE[role]===part`. `partHolds(part, plane)` for the unroled bits: whole true; backdrop `plane!=="near"`; subject `plane==="near"`; plane `part===plane`.
3. **svg.ts `artSvg`**: replace `backdrop`/`subject` booleans, keeping push order so whole/backdrop/subject stay byte for byte. Sky rect, rays, vignette: `partHolds(part,"far")`; glow `partDraws(part,"light")`; ridge runs `partDraws(part, runRole)` (replaces `drawn`); motif glyphs and accent `"props"`; emblem `"subject"`; motes `"motes"`; `particleMarkup` `partHolds(part,"nearest")`. Split the vignette from the particles' `if`. **stinkyscape.ts / traininggrounds.ts**: `behindSubject = partHolds(part,"far")`, `figure = partDraws(part,"subject")`; split the tail: particles `partHolds(part,"nearest")`, vignette `partHolds(part,"far")` (TG's shadow ellipse stays under `behindSubject`). `partKey` in svg.ts already keys any part.
4. **CardArt.tsx**: `export function hasArtPlanes(defId, starship, picture: ArtPicture, radiant, manifest = ART_MANIFEST): boolean` = `hasArtParts(defId, starship) && restyleOf(picture)===null && (picture==="alt" || artUrl(defId, radiant, manifest)===null)`. No change inside `CardArt`: a non-"whole" part already makes it draw the painter.
5. **depth.ts**: `drawsPlanes({rarity, fullArt, version, glitch, planed, flat})` true only when `!flat && planed && !glitch`, version is none of Immersive, Out of frame, Extended art, and (`rarity` is Epic/Legendary/Mythic or `fullArt`). `breaksFrame(rarity, ownHand, tilt)`: Legendary/Mythic and (`ownHand` or tilt is `"window"`/`"drag"`). `GLARE_BY_FOIL: Record<string,{art,frame}>`: none .30/.16, foil-holo-sweep .55/.20, foil-rainbow .50/.20, foil-cracked-ice .60/.12, foil-glitter .50/.10, foil-sunburst .45/.30, foil-aurora .45/.18, foil-galaxy .40/.14, foil-molten-gold .35/.35, foil-void-shimmer .25/.10. `glareFor(foilId|undefined, radiant)`: that row; Radiant takes the none row with `frame` 0 (leaves its gold frame alone). `useDepthMotion(): {flat, fxOff}`: `flat = useSetting("reduceMotion") || useOsReducedMotion() || useFxSettings()[0].intensity==="off"`, `fxOff = intensity==="off"`.
6. **tilt.ts**: `export type TiltMode = "off"|"host"|"window"|"drag"`. Pure: `pointerPose(x,y,rect)` → `{x,y}` in −1..1 from the rect's middle, clamped, 0 for a zero side; `devicePose(gamma,beta)` = `tiltShift` from immersive.ts; `tiltDegrees(pose)` = `{rx: -pose.y*CARD_TILT_MAX_DEG, ry: pose.x*CARD_TILT_MAX_DEG}`; `glareOf(pose)` = `{x: 50 - pose.x*CARD_GLARE_TRAVEL_PCT, y: 50 - pose.y*CARD_GLARE_TRAVEL_PCT}`. One face at a time: module `owner` token with priority host 1 < window 2 < drag 3; `claim(token, priority)` succeeds if free or `priority >= owner's` (the old owner releases); `useTiltHold(held)` sets a module flag while mounted and notifies subscribers. `useCardTilt(faceRef, mode, allowed)`: `host = faceRef.current?.parentElement`; inactive unless `mode!=="off" && allowed && !held`. `write(pose)` claims, then sets on the face `--cf-tilt-x/-y` (3 digits), `--cf-tilt-rx/-ry` (`"<n>deg"`), `--cf-glare-x/-y` (`"<n>%"`) and `dataset.tilt="on"`; `release()` removes them all and the slot (the CSS transition is the spring).
   - `host` mode: `pointerenter`/`pointermove` on host for `pointerType!=="touch"` (the tests' `MouseEvent` has none); `pointerdown` engages for any type; release on `pointerleave`/`pointerup`/`pointercancel`.
   - `window` mode: passive window `pointermove` for non-touch; release on `document.documentElement` `pointerleave`/`blur`.
   - `drag` mode: window mode plus native `pointerdown`/`move`/`up`/`cancel` on host for touch. It calls `stopPropagation()` on that `pointerdown` (so `useSheetSwipe` does not start) and sets `host.style.touchAction="none"` while mounted (restore on cleanup).
   - Pose always comes from the host's rect, since the face itself rotates.
   - Device tilt: while engaged (host: pressed or hovered; window/drag: from mount) and `useCardSettings().deviceTilt`, a passive `deviceorientation` listener writes `devicePose(event.gamma, event.beta)` (skip null).
   - Rule 7: it reads no view.
7. **Settings**. settings.ts: `deviceTilt: boolean` in `CardSettings`, default `false`,

## Goal

Cards move like cards, all in the web client (`apps/web`) and keyed on public events and the player's own input (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Done means:

- a hand play flies on an arc from the hand, or from where the drag let go, to its tile;
- the deck riffles once per action;
- the opening hand is dealt one card at a time and a tap skips it;
- the hand springs on `--ease-overshoot`;
- the drag ghost tilts with its speed and a missed drop springs home;
- six new sounds and a pick-up haptic fire once per event;
- Speed (R201), reduced motion and fx intensity off are honoured.

Two things the issue assumes are not in the code:

- The client has no hand reorder, so "parts the cards around the gap" has nothing to build.

last_findings.claim: `CosmeticHoldings::holds` checks the default look against the live shipped `registry()`, not against the logged `droppable` entries the roll was given, so a cosmetic-pack opening logged before #3343 no longer replays to the same slots.
last_findings.evidence: `holds(card_id, id)` now ends with `|| registry().iter().any(|cosmetic| cosmetic.id == id && is_default_look(cosmetic, card_id))`. It is called from `open_places` (lines 193-194) and from `slot_grant`'s `below` filter (line 280), and both already hold the `&Cosmetic` from `droppable`. `CosmeticOpeningLog` (lines 122-142) promises that `roll_cosmetic_pack` over the logged `cosmetics` 'replays it however the live catalog or registry has moved since'. R3343000 also claims 'an opening's log keeps the registry it was rolled against'. A log from before #3343 holds `version-full-art` with no `defaultOn`. `offered` reads that logged entry and still places it on core-100. `holds` reads the live entry, which now has `defaultOn: [Mythic]`, so it reports the level as held. The pool and the `below` list both change, and so do the slots. `roll.rs` `duplicate_grant` gets this right, because it calls `is_default_look(cosmetic, card_id)` on the droppable entry, so the two rolls now disagree. No test catches it: `assert_replays` only replays logs written by the same build. Fix: pass the `&Cosmetic` from `droppable` to `holds`, or call `is_default_look(level, card)` at the three call sites, and drop the live `registry()` lookup. That also removes a full scan of the registry on every `holds` call in the pool loops. Add a test that replays a log whose `cosmetics` lack `defaultOn`.

## Goal

Every face-up Legendary or Mythic permanent on the board gets a tile aura under its card, in the colours of its own picture. Legendary gets a soft edge glow and slow motes. Mythic gets a richer pattern chosen by its set's look: runes, starfield, roots, circuitry or ink. A card's own table `aura` (signature) replaces the default. A touch on the card or its tile sends a ripple, plays a soft bell in the aura's colour, and buzzes on a phone. The aura brightens while the card is picked as a target, flickers on damage, dims while Dormant, Frozen or Silenced, and fades out with its `destroyed` or `exiled` row. It stays under the particle budgets, is still under reduced motion, and is off at fx intensity off. It is presentation only: no engine, wire or catalog change.

Design choice: the aura is a DOM element inside each `.zone`, not another canvas layer. `AuraLayer` is a fixed overlay above the cards and cannot sit under them. `.card` is `position: relative`, so an absolutely positioned first child of `.zone` paints below it.
